finding.rationale: Direct typed process creation is the required backend lifecycle boundary. The launcher uses a fixed adapter-generated argument array, shell=false, no standard input, discarded child streams, CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows, an allowlisted child environment, explicit first-run approval, and no AI/provider output as executable input. Removing subprocess would remove the required supervised-launch capability; suppressing the finding would discard useful scanner evidence.

limitations: Bandit evidence is rule-based static analysis, not proof of total security.
The finding remains visible and is not suppressed with a nosec annotation.
